verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented power envelope for the RTX 5080: no TDP, TGP, board power or sustained-load power figures. The vendor's "studio-class power and efficiency" line is generic marketing, not a power specification. The only independent performance-per-watt observation says the older 4080 Super has the better perf-per-watt ratio and lower temps, so it does not show the 5080 being power-efficient under sustained workloads.
